title: Yummy Bouncy Cornish Cheese Curds Cheesy Sausage Mash
description: A comforting and satisfying Cornish-inspired dish featuring crispy bouncy cheese curds, cheesy sausages, and creamy mash.
instructions: Cook the sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the cooked sausages to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the butter and melt over medium heat.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually pour in the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the grated cheddar until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked sausages back into the skillet and stir to coat with the cheesy sauce.
In a separate pot, boil the potatoes until tender, then drain and mash with a fork.
Add a splash of milk to the mashed potatoes to achieve a creamy consistency.
Transfer the mashed potatoes to a serving dish and top with the cheesy sausage mixture.
Sprinkle the dried cheese curds over the top and return to the oven for an additional 5-7 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
